How Starbucks really
makes its money

lines.text: About 2 out of 3 Starbucks drinks in the US are cold.
lines.say: About two out of three Starbucks drinks in the US are cold.

lines.text: That's Starbucks' own number from January 2026, for its US company-run stores.
lines.say: That's Starbucks' own number from January twenty twenty-six, for its US company-run stores.

lines.text: In money terms, cold hit 75% of US beverage sales one summer quarter in 2023; hot, just 25%.
lines.say: In money terms, cold hit seventy-five percent of US beverage sales one summer quarter in twenty twenty-three; hot, just twenty-five.

lines.text: So the classic hot cup of coffee is now the smaller business.
lines.say: So the classic hot cup of coffee is now the smaller business.

lines.text: Why? CEO Brian Niccol said in October 2026 that cold drinks usually come in a bigger size, and people add cold foam.
lines.say: Why? CEO Brian Niccol said in October twenty twenty-six that cold drinks usually come in a bigger size, and people add cold foam.

scene.text: Customers moving to cold, which also results in usually a little bit bigger size, and then the idea of modifying with cold foam

lines.text: Add-ons like that are big money: Starbucks said in 2023 they bring in over $1 billion a year.
lines.say: Add-ons like that are big money: Starbucks said in twenty twenty-three they bring in over one billion dollars a year.

lines.text: And drinks drive the whole company: 61% of revenue in fiscal 2025, versus 19% for food.
lines.say: And drinks drive the whole company: sixty-one percent of revenue in fiscal twenty twenty-five, versus nineteen percent for food.

lines.text: So an iced drink usually means a bigger cup, extras, and a bigger check.
lines.say: So an iced drink usually means a bigger cup, extras, and a bigger check.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Why cold drinks bring Starbucks more sales than hot coffee
post.ig:
About 2 out of 3 Starbucks drinks in the US are cold (Starbucks, Jan 2026).
In one summer quarter of 2023, cold was 75% of US beverage sales.
CEO Brian Niccol (Oct 2026): cold drinks usually come in a bigger size, and people add cold foam.
Add-ons brought in over $1B a year (Starbucks, 2023). Drinks were 61% of revenue in fiscal 2025 (10-K).
Sources: Starbucks 10-K FY2025, earnings calls Aug 2023 and Oct 2026, Investor Day Jan 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
